title: Frontend Developer
description: Build fast, accessible interfaces for a design tool used by 40,000 teams. You will own features end to end, from component architecture to performance budgets, and partner closely with design.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Design and scale event-driven services that process millions of requests a day. You will mentor engineers, shape our API standards and lead reliability improvements across the platform.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Lead a six-month redesign of a wellness app, running research sessions, prototyping flows and shipping a design system. Ideal for a designer who loves turning messy problems into calm interfaces.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create social campaigns, packaging and event visuals for local food and lifestyle brands. You will work in a small studio with real client briefs and weekly critiques.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn sales and inventory data into clear dashboards and weekly insights for merchandising teams. You will write SQL daily and learn how a large retailer makes data-driven decisions.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Plan and run paid, email and lifecycle campaigns for a fast-growing gardening subscription. You will own the funnel metrics and test new channels every sprint.

title: Senior Product Designer
description: Shape how small businesses send and receive payments. You will define product strategy with PMs, craft end-to-end flows and raise the craft bar across a team of eight designers.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Join a structured graduate programme building logistics software. Expect paired programming, code reviews and a rotation through backend, mobile and QA teams in your first year.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Help us build a patient scheduling portal on a three-month engagement. You will ship features across a Node API and a React front end, with a focus on privacy and reliability.

title: Product Management Intern
description: Spend six months supporting the roadmap of a bike-sharing app. You will analyse usage data, interview riders and write specs that engineers actually build.

title: Content Strategist
description: Define editorial direction for a publishing brand's newsletters and blog. You will plan content calendars, edit freelancers and measure what readers love.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Work with researchers to train and evaluate language models for customer support. You will run experiments, clean datasets and present findings to the team each fortnight.

title: Business Development Associate
description: Source and qualify partnership opportunities for an early-stage venture fund. You will research markets, build financial summaries and sit in on founder meetings.

title: iOS Developer
description: Rebuild the onboarding and portfolio screens of a personal finance app in SwiftUI. You will work with one designer and one backend engineer on a four-month contract.

title: Brand Identity Designer
description: Create a complete identity for a new outdoor apparel label, from logo and colour system to packaging and launch assets. Portfolio with brand work required.

title: Data Engineer
description: Own the pipelines that move shipment data from sensors to dashboards. You will design batch and streaming jobs, enforce data quality and help the analytics team move faster.
